propositions: JiraDataCenterTransport.update_issue submits status as a REST field edit instead of routing it through transition_issue_by_name, causing Jira to reject the status change silently since status is not an editable field
JiraCloudTransport.acli pops status and routes it to transition_issue_by_name, but JiraDataCenterTransport lacks equivalent status routing, creating a transport-specific implementation gap

Outbound status mutations fail against DC with status remaining unchanged while the apply phase reports success, because update_issue never calls the transition resolver that maps destination status names to transition IDs
The fix must pop status from update_issue kwargs and route it through transition_issue_by_name, while keeping other allowlisted fields in the field-edit path in the same call
Illegal transitions from the current workflow state must remain non-fatal and observable as bridge alerts rather than silently failing, maintaining the soft-failure contract
